IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Alexander, Haler, Chandler, Bailey and Kretz

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring notice of appropriations legislation before legislative votes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to appropriations legislation; adding new sectionsto chapter 44.04 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 44.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that approval of the state budget is the mostimportant act of the legislature in any year, having profoundconsequences for every resident of the state. The legislature furtherfinds that the public is entitled to a reasonable opportunity to learnhow public funds are proposed to be expended before bills makingappropriations become law. The legislature further finds that publicnotice, dissemination of information, and informed analysis of proposedbudgets is an essential requisite of transparent, accountablegovernment. The legislature finds that omnibus appropriations bills frequentlyhave been acted on by the legislature in a manner that has affordedlittle opportunity for public review and information about proposedexpenditures, or for members of the legislature to deliberate upon suchlegislation in an informed and conscientious manner. The legislature p. 1 HB 1834finds that this practice has weakened the performance of thelegislature in its stewardship of public funds, and reduced publictrust in government. The legislature finds that many other states, intheir constitutions, statutes, or legislative rules, require anopportunity for public and legislative review of budget legislation. The legislature therefore finds that it is in the public interestto provide for an appropriate period of public and legislative reviewof all omnibus appropriations bills before they are acted on by thelegislature and submitted to the governor for approval.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 44.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An omnibus operating, capital, or transportation appropriationsbill, or any other bill that implements an omnibus operating, capital,or transportation appropriations bill and is effective for the sameperiod as such appropriations bill, must be made publicly available tothe members of the legislature and the public at least five calendardays before such bill may be voted on by the senate or the house ofrepresentatives.
This act shall be known and cited as thebudget sunshine act of 2007.
